'''Zakala Trad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], she sold specialized gear for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in the Combat Training section of [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trad first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a level 50 Battlemaster PVP Gear vendor.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
